season: The Devil's Plan Season 3: Dead Again
seasonZh: 魔鬼的计谋 第三季：死亡重启

tagline.zh: 10轮秘密二选一政治博弈（公共利益 vs 个人私利），穿插4场脑力小游戏争夺生活馆席位与联盟徽章。
tagline.en: 10 secret binary dilemmas pitting public prize pool against personal survival, interlaced with 4 high-stakes mini-games.

tagline.zh: 3D 等轴测立体堆叠空间速算，精准推导被遮挡隐藏方块总数，答错将触发 20 秒锁定惩罚。
tagline.en: Isometric 3D stacked-cube speed counting with occluded hidden blocks — wrong guesses trigger a 20-second lockout.

tagline.zh: 在数字网格中找出所有格内之和等于目标值的矩形；支持单打独赢 7 分，或 ≤3 人组队进行独食 (5/1/1) 与奉献 (1/3/3) 博弈。
tagline.en: Count every sub-rectangle matching the target sum; go solo for 7 pts or form a 3-player team with Monopoly (5/1/1) vs Devotion (1/3/3) splits.

tagline.zh: 16 张扑克牌限时 20 秒记忆后全数翻面，结合 3 张公共牌盲选 2 张暗牌组成最强 5 张德州牌型。
tagline.en: Memorize 16 cards in 20 seconds before they flip face-down; pick 2 hidden cards to forge the strongest 5-card hand with 3 community cards.

tagline.zh: 114 格公园棋盘，低分优先挑选 7 种尺寸多联骨牌 {3,4,6,7,9,11,13}，按从小到大轮流放置（仅旋转、禁翻转）卡位封杀。
tagline.en: 114-cell park grid: lowest scorer drafts first from 7 polyomino sizes {3–13}, placing smallest-to-largest (rotate only) to out-block rivals.

tagline.zh: 24 轮 7 只神秘股票暗箱操盘！10万起始资金，R5/10/15/20 逐步解密涨跌公式，支持 Secret 隐匿下单与 1000 万奖金徽章冲刺。
tagline.en: 24 rounds across 7 enigmatic stocks with hidden price formulas revealed at R5/10/15/20. Use Secret orders, Piece intel, and race for 10M KRW.

tagline.zh: 3 轮 13 张牌（11宝石 + 2炸弹 -6/-4）正逆序强制暗换；终局得分 = 己分 × 秘密伙伴(Manito)分，负负得正惊天逆转！
tagline.en: 3 rounds of forward & reverse card swaps among 11 Gems and 2 Bombs (-6/-4). Final score = Own × Secret Manito — negative × negative wins!

tagline.zh: 7 轮同款 3×3 ○△☆ 宾果盘，7 张名牌 + 10 枚不可拆全付硬币暗拍！得标量等于同选该图形人数，且胜者全程保密。
tagline.en: 7 rounds on identical 3×3 ○△☆ boards with 7 Name Tickets & 10 non-splittable all-pay coins. Blind auction winners claim tiles equal to selector count.

tagline.zh: 14 轮两循环暗出 0–6 岩石卡与红/绿/蓝/彩虹筹码，三座底座任一凑满 ≥13 即爆仓吞下整座岩石总罚分。
tagline.en: 14 rounds of simultaneous 0–6 rock cards and color/rainbow chips. Push any stand to ≥13 and bust, absorbing every rock on that stand.

tagline.zh: 6 弹仓 2 实弹，每人 16 枚秘密点数！公开/私密查验、拨转弹仓或 6 点暗拍众筹交换相邻弹仓，3 人归零瞬间顺时针连发。
tagline.en: 6 chambers, 2 live bullets, 16 secret credits. Peek, spin, or secretly crowd-fund 6 credits to swap chambers before 3 empty players trigger fire.

tagline.zh: 5 只存钱罐初始各 1 黑 1 白币，投 1–5 币传递；接罐者 20 秒报黑白交替累计数，10 秒抢铃质疑 (+1/-1)，先到 5 分胜出。
tagline.en: 5 piggy banks start with 1B+1W coin. Drop 1–5 coins & pass; receiver has 20s to call alternating B/W totals under a 10s Doubt buzzer (+1/-1) to 5 pts.

tagline.zh: 7×7 棋盘，方棋（直线 1–2 格）与圆棋（1 格或 90° L 拐）分兵作战，禁原地不动、每步必落一墙，R1 三人还握有唯一破墙杀招！
tagline.en: 7×7 territory duel: Square pieces move straight 1–2, Circle pieces step 1 or L-turn 90°. Mandatory movement + 1 wall per turn, plus R1 Wall Break.

tagline.zh: 流放地首战：精密观察 8 枚立体凹槽魔鬼碎片的齿槽方向与深度，旋转互锁拼成严丝合缝的石阵网格。
tagline.en: Exile Trial 1: Inspect groove depths and notches across 8 Devil's Pieces to interlock them into a seamless stone grid before rivals.

tagline.zh: 限时死记流放地神殿原始壁画，随后在改版壁画中高速精准点出全部 5 处细微篡改，末位即刻永久淘汰。
tagline.en: Memorize the original ancient temple mural under the clock, then race to pinpoint all 5 subtle alterations on the mutated fresco.

tagline.zh: 26 张 A–Z 字母卡各带唯一「数字 + 颜色 + 图形」三重属性，依据逻辑线索交叉排除，抢铃锁定唯一 4 字母密码。
tagline.en: 26 A–Z cards each carry a unique Number, Color & Shape signature. Cross-deduce layered logic clues and buzz in the sole 4-letter code.

tagline.zh: 高难度数回 (Slitherlink) 逻辑竞速：按格子数字 0–3 沿点阵架设围栏，连成唯一无交叉、无分叉的闭合单环。
tagline.en: High-tension Slitherlink race: connect dot-grid edges matching every 0–3 clue into one continuous, non-branching closed loop.

tagline.zh: 将蓝、红、绿三组多联几何模块分别拼成 3 个完美轴对称图形，前两名死里逃生、末位彻底告别流放地。
tagline.en: Assemble Blue, Red, and Green polyomino sets into 3 exact mirror-symmetrical silhouettes — top two survive Exile, last falls forever.

tagline.zh: 穿行红蓝选择之房与 15 区象形古语壁画！限时 1 小时，首行正中锁定 1，将 1–49 填入 7×7 玄武岩石碑使行列对角线皆等于 175。
tagline.en: Enter the Red/Blue Choice Room & decode the 15-zone Exile Cipher. Lock 1 at top-center and fill 1–49 into a 7×7 tablet summing to 175 on every line.

tagline.zh: 沉浸式四幕密室机关：撬开假插座插入 1 碎片→紫外显影 `?`→12 枚碎片齿轮互锁开密梯→直面「诅咒结界」与 2 亿奖金徽章的终极抉择！
tagline.en: 4-act interactive suite escape room: pry the fake outlet, reveal the UV `?`, interlock 12 Devil's Pieces to open the hidden elevator & face the Curse Barrier.
